title: JSON Schema
description: A JSON Schema 2020-12 document. The x-form keyword adjusts how jsonhandler renders a form for it.

x-form.title: x-form
x-form.description: Form annotations. They change how the form looks, never what JSON it produces.

widget.description: The control to use instead of the default for the schema's type.

label.description: The field's label. Defaults to the schema's title, then the property name.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text. Defaults to the default value of an optional field, or the first example.

order.description: Property names to show first, in this order. The rest follow in the order the schema lists them.

class.description: Extra class names for the field's wrapper element.

collapsed.description: Whether an optional value starts out left out, behind an add button. By default only deprecated values and values whose schema repeats an enclosing one do.

rows.description: The number of text rows of a textarea or json widget.

messages.description: Messages to show instead of the validator's, by the keyword that failed, such as pattern, minimum or required.
